items.title: Roger Kellaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: other times when I’ve improvised with Eddie Daniels for instance

ctx.x: Until we recorded it. The CD has not been released, there’s a CD called “Timepiece” that’s in the can. And on that session Bob and I decided to do a dorian mode improvisation before we start the tune. So I don’t know when the tune is going to start, but I do know that’s the tune that it’s hooked up to. There are other times when I’ve improvised with Eddie Daniels for instance where we just start and we go and whatever happens and whatever the tune emerges is the tune that emerges, if it does.
You mean you don’t even have a goal down the road in mind? It may come into — he may start playing “These Foolish Things” or something, and—
